## Invitations

A total of 417 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was limited, with 5 people attending. This represents an attendance rate of 1.2 per cent. The results indicate that the invitation process generated little participation and that further attention may be required to support engagement with invited people.

The attendance outcome will be considered alongside the contact activity recorded for the period. Staff should continue to review whether the invitation approach is reaching people effectively and whether additional support is needed to encourage attendance.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded as 0, and reminders were also recorded as 0. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, as part of ongoing follow-up.

These contact results should be monitored with attendance information to identify opportunities for improvement. Maintaining contact with people who do not attend remains an important part of the outreach process.
